annotation.title_clean: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.title_en: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nunnari, F.; Tsovaltzi, D.; Lavit Nicora, M.; Beyrodt, S.; Prajod, P.; Chehayeb, L. et al.
annotation.summary_en: Research article from the EU MindBot project presenting a 'covatar' (cobot plus avatar) and the transparent BASSF emotional model driven by PAD signals to co-regulate worker emotions in industrial assembly. Two empirical studies (N=20, N=12) support Dominance's link to self-efficacy and flow and suggest wellbeing benefits.
key_provisions_or_claims: BASSF is a transparent, theory-based model of boredom, anxiety, self-efficacy, self-compassion and flow
PAD signals are noisy and need pre-filtering and per-user calibration
Study 1: Dominance predicts self-efficacy and flow
Study 2 suggests socially interactive cobots can support wellbeing and job satisfaction
Calls for explainable, controllable interventions in worker-cobot interaction
